verdict.rationale: Checkout.com offers hosted payment pages, Flow, mobile SDKs, and payment links that are explicitly marketed as reducing compliance burden ('no confusing compliance'), and also supports tokens/network tokens/payment instruments as an alternative to raw card data, all of which are standard mechanisms for keeping card data off merchant servers and reducing PCI scope. However, no evidence explicitly names PCI DSS, SAQ levels, or describes tokenization architecture/vaulting in detail, and the API also documents accepting 'full card details' directly, meaning scope reduction depends on which integration path a developer chooses. Missing for 10: explicit PCI DSS compliance/SAQ-A scope-reduction documentation, dedicated tokenization/vaulting API docs, and independent confirmation of scope-reduction claims.
